name: Oracle

IC2.dsaDepth: Moderate — a 3-hour technical interview is reported, with less-standardized loop structure than Google/Amazon
rounds: Technical interview(s), reportedly a single long session (~3 hrs) for some IC2 loops
extraTopics: Team-dependent depth (OCI/cloud teams lean distributed systems; enterprise teams lean Java/C++ and SQL)

IC3.dsaDepth: Moderate–Heavy — 2 one-hour technical sessions with principal-level engineers, resume-driven
rounds: Two separate 1-hour technical interviews with principal-level engineers, close to day-to-day work rather than abstract algorithms
extraTopics: Practical, job-like problems rather than pure LeetCode
Resume defense — reports describe every bullet point becoming fair game

IC4 (OCI / Principal).dsaDepth: Moderate–Heavy — distributed-systems and cloud-architecture design questions
rounds: System design round (e.g. a live block-storage migration with no clean textbook answer for OCI-focused teams)
extraTopics: Multi-tenant cloud architecture, network virtualization, distributed storage trade-offs
IC4 (OCI / Principal).notes: Loop composition is markedly team-dependent — OCI/cloud teams differ a lot from enterprise/campus tracks.
